name: Role Model / Martyr
life_theme: Learn through experimentation in the first half of life, then become a role model for authentic living.
work_pattern: Early career marked by experimentation and honest mistakes. This builds real credibility. From mid-life, the 6/3 embodies what they've learned and naturally becomes an inspiration to others who see their authentic journey.
career_approach: Allow early career experimentation without self-judgment. Each trial teaches something real. From 35+, begin consciously living and expressing the values you've discovered. Your authentic story is your authority.
growth_edge: Trusting that the experimental phase was necessary and not a waste of time.
